`web/src/connect.ts`

This is the single place where the ConnectRPC transport and service clients are created:

- `web/src/connect.ts:184` — the main `createConnectTransport({...})` with the auth interceptor
- `web/src/connect.ts:192-203` — all exported clients via `createClient(...)`: `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, `identityProviderServiceClient`
- `web/src/connect.ts:65-72` — a separate interceptor-free `refreshTransport` and `refreshAuthClient` used for token refresh (avoids recursion)
